```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 9)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DBI); library(RMariaDB); library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(scales)
})
```

```{r connect}
# The password is never a parameter: RStudio saves the knit parameters with the
# document, and a committed .Rmd would carry the credential with it.
con <- dbConnect(
  RMariaDB::MariaDB(),
  host = params$db_host, port = params$db_port, dbname = params$db_name,
  user = Sys.getenv("DB_USER", "paris_analytics"),
  password = Sys.getenv("DB_PASSWORD")
)
knitr::knit_hooks$set(document = function(x) { dbDisconnect(con); x })

spots <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT s.id, s.category, s.arrondissement, s.canopy_score, s.water_access,
         s.is_free, a.label, a.area_km2, a.population
  FROM cool_spots s
  JOIN arrondissements a ON a.code = s.arrondissement")

scores <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT s.*, a.label
  FROM arrondissement_scores s
  JOIN arrondissements a ON a.code = s.code
  WHERE s.computed_on = (SELECT MAX(computed_on) FROM arrondissement_scores)")
```

## Combien de lieux, et où ?

```{r inventory}
by_arr <- spots %>%
  count(label, category) %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = unique(label[order(as.integer(sub("e|er", "", label)))])))

ggplot(by_arr, aes(x = label, y = n, fill = category)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Catégorie") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Nombre de lieux",
       title = "Inventaire des îlots de fraîcheur par arrondissement") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Densité contre qualité

Deux arrondissements peuvent afficher le même nombre de lieux sans offrir le
même confort : c'est l'écart entre la densité et le score de canopée.

```{r density-quality}
summary_arr <- spots %>%
  group_by(label, area_km2) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), canopy = mean(canopy_score), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(per_km2 = n / area_km2)

ggplot(summary_arr, aes(x = per_km2, y = canopy, label = label)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), colour = "#0ea5e9", alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_text(vjust = -1, size = 3) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Lieux", range = c(2, 9)) +
  labs(x = "Lieux par km²", y = "Score de canopée moyen",
       title = "Densité et qualité ne vont pas de pair") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## Indice de vulnérabilité

Calculé par `vulnerability_index.R` : 100 signifie l'arrondissement le moins
bien couvert pendant une canicule.

```{r vulnerability}
ggplot(scores, aes(x = reorder(label, vulnerability_index), y = vulnerability_index,
                   fill = factor(cluster))) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "YlOrRd", name = "Groupe") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Indice de vulnérabilité",
       title = "Arrondissements les plus exposés à la chaleur") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r table}
scores %>%
  arrange(desc(vulnerability_index)) %>%
  select(Arrondissement = label, `Lieux / km²` = spots_per_km2,
         `Canopée` = mean_canopy_score, `Indice` = vulnerability_index,
         `Groupe` = cluster) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```
